verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own site claims in-product AI agents that monitor the product continuously, surface insights unprompted, and recommend next steps. It also claims AI that spots trends across replays and heatmaps, AI summaries of replay playlists, and diagnosis of what changed delivered as a dashboard, illustrated by a sample insight ('Signups dipped 19% last week'). The hosted MCP server is not credited here, because it works through external assistants rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the in-product AI insights/agents feature (all evidence is homepage marketing copy), detail on how suggestions are generated or acted on, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
